title: Meeting people
phrases: Hi, nice to meet you.
Where are you from?
What do you do for a living?
I work as a software developer.
I moved here three years ago.
It was great talking to you.

title: Job interview
phrases: Thank you for having me today.
I have five years of experience.
I led a team of eight people.
My greatest strength is solving problems.
I would love to work with your team.
Could you tell me more about the role?

title: At work
phrases: Can everyone see my screen?
Let me share the latest numbers.
I will send the report by Friday.
Could we move the meeting to Thursday?
That is a very good point.
I think we should wait a week.

title: On the phone
phrases: Could you repeat that, please?
Sorry, the line is breaking up.
I am calling about my order.
Can I call you back in ten minutes?
Could you speak a little slower, please?
Thanks for your help, have a good day.

title: Out and about
phrases: A table for two, please.
Could I have a glass of water?
I would like a coffee with milk.
How much is this one?
Where is the nearest station?
Can I pay by card?

title: Small talk
phrases: How was your weekend?
The weather is lovely today.
Have you watched anything good lately?
I went hiking with my family.
What are your plans for the holidays?
That sounds like a lot of fun.

title: Presentations
phrases: Thank you all for coming.
Today I will talk about three things.
Let me start with the big picture.
You can see the results on this slide.
Sales went up by thirty percent.
I am happy to take your questions.

title: Helping a customer
phrases: Hello, how can I help you today?
May I have your order number, please?
Let me check that for you.
I am very sorry for the trouble.
Your refund will reach you in five days.
Is there anything else I can help with?

title: Tongue twisters
phrases: Three thin thieves thought a thousand thoughts.
We wove a very warm vest in the west.
Vivid waves washed over the wet village.
Zebras zip through the breezy zoo.
Fifty fine fish found a fresh pond.
This thing and that thing are both theirs.
Peter picked a pack of perfect peppers.
Victor wants a very wide window.
The cat sat back and had a nap.
